scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('www/supabase',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('index.html','www/index.html');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('supabase').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js')))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('supabase',f),p.join('www/supabase',f));if(!fs.existsSync('www/supabase/cloud-portal.js'))throw Error('Supabase cloud portal missing from Android assets');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
